    A few things you might ask

    Good questions.
    Straight answers.

    Do you work on homes and businesses?

    Yes. CommuniCable provides services for residential, commercial and industrial properties. We’ll help you work out which solution suits your space.

    Which areas do you cover?

    Paul and the team arrange quotes for locations from Sydney to Newcastle. Call us with your suburb and we can discuss your project.

    Can you help with more than one service?

    Yes. Our services cover security, data and voice, electrical work, and TV and antenna systems. Let us know what you need so we can plan the work together.

    How do I get a quote?

    Call 1800 180 747 or speak to Paul on 0417 822 188. Tell us about your property and what you’d like to achieve, and we’ll discuss the next steps.
